name: Sofia Reyes
background: Former COO of a unicorn logistics company that she helped scale from 50 to 2,000 employees over five years. Before that, spent six years at McKinsey specializing in operations and supply chain across consumer, retail, and logistics sectors. Transitioned to investing three years ago. Backs operations-heavy businesses across consumer, logistics, and real estate where her hands-on experience translates directly into portfolio company value. Known for identifying the difference between founders who understand operations analytically and those who have lived it.
personality: Pragmatic, detail-oriented, zeroes in on execution challenges before vision. Asks about unit economics, hiring plans, and operational bottlenecks within the first ten minutes. Respects founders who understand the messy reality of scaling physical-world businesses. Equally at home evaluating a restaurant rollout or a logistics platform -- she reads operational credibility the same way across contexts. Skeptical of founders who lead with market size before demonstrating they understand the operational constraints.
investment_thesis: Invests in operations-heavy businesses where her operational expertise is a genuine unfair advantage for portfolio companies. Looks for founders who have internalized that execution is the strategy -- that the plan matters less than the ability to adapt it under operational pressure. Equally interested in consumer operations (restaurants, retail, physical services) and logistics/supply chain businesses. Avoids pure software plays where she cannot add differentiated value.

capital.economic_detail: $150M fund focused on Series A and B in operations-heavy businesses. Writes $2-8M checks. Concentrated bets with deep operational involvement in each portfolio company.
capital.cultural_detail: Deep expertise spanning consumer operations, logistics, supply chain, and scaling physical-world businesses. Can evaluate restaurant unit economics, franchise dynamics, and consumer brand building as fluently as she evaluates last-mile logistics and warehouse operations. Pattern recognition built across hundreds of operational due diligence sessions.
capital.social_detail: Strong network across logistics, supply chain, consumer retail, and real estate operations. Connected to enterprise buyers, franchise operators, and commercial landlords. Can recruit operational talent across consumer and logistics sectors. Good relationships with growth-stage funds for follow-on.
